senses.sense_definition: The state or quality of being bizarre, distorted, or macabre, or something that exhibits these characteristics.

examples.text: The artist was famous for the sheer <w>grotesquerie</w> of his distorted carnival portraits.
She was unsettled by the eerie <w>grotesquerie</w> of the shadowy figures lining the corridor.

senses.sense_definition: A subgenre of horror or weird fiction popular in the early 20th century featuring distorted, macabre, or supernatural elements.

examples.text: Early twentieth-century authors often turned to literary <w>grotesquerie</w> to explore themes of psychological decay.
His short stories became famous examples of American <w>grotesquerie</w> alongside works by Bierce.
